name: sc036-artifacts-first-publication
description: 036 T053, FR-022/SC-008 — a first publication of a whole feature directory, compared across the two ports. Every artifact of specs/001-reporting reaches the specification ticket in ONE multipart request, announced by ONE comment, and both ports must agree byte for byte on four things at once: the comment's ADF body, the multipart part list and its order, the Jira call sequence, and the summary's artifacts[] array. `git_branch` is required, not decorative: the artifact set is `git ls-files` over the feature directory (research R5), and without a repository the set is empty and this scenario compares two identical no-ops. The fixture holds only text artifacts — a tracked binary is subject to the checkout's own line-ending conversion on a Windows runner, which would make the divergence a property of git rather than of either port; byte fidelity for binaries is asserted at the unit level, where the fixture is written at run time.
